eras.name: The Ancient Mythic Age
eras.description: The dawn of gods, primal dragons, and the shaping of the world.

eras.name: The Ruin & Cataclysm
eras.description: Planar cataclysm, shattered continents, and sunken kingdoms.

eras.name: The Century of Iron
eras.description: Rise of mortal empires, grand citadels, and mercantile guilds.

eras.name: Current Campaign Arc
eras.description: Active campaign timeline and live party milestones.

events.title: The Forging of the World-Spire & First Iron-Oak
events.description: Aureon and Sylvara bind the primordial elemental chaos beneath the Shattered Coast and plant the colossal Iron-Oak at the heart of what will become Oakhaven.

events.title: The First Dragon Concord of the Ironpeaks
events.description: Ancient metallic and chromatic wyrms carve out the northern mountain vaults before retreating into centuries-long slumber.

events.title: The Night of Falling Stars & Sinking of Old Oakhaven
events.description: A catastrophic planar rift tears open above the coast. Half of Old Oakhaven collapses beneath the sea, creating the flooded Sunken Ward and submerging the royal catacombs.

events.title: Sealing of the Obsidian Sanctum
events.description: Archmages and Dawn-Paladins lock the Shadowfell breach beneath the catacombs using the Obsidian Key, swearing an oath to guard the seal forever.

events.title: Founding of the Cinder-Forge & Silver Bastion
events.description: Dwarven smith-clans ignite the great blast furnaces of the Cinder-Forge while the Order of the Silver Gauntlet raises the white marble walls of Highspire.

events.title: The Grand Exchange Charter & Rise of the Syndicate
events.description: The Gilded Scales Consortium secures monopoly rights over maritime trade, inadvertently driving independent captains into the arms of the Obsidian Syndicate.

events.title: The Adventuring Party Convenes at the Rusted Anchor
events.description: Our heroes gather in Oakhaven as tensions boil over between the Silver Gauntlet, the striking Ironbound dockworkers, and whispers of a Pale Moon ritual in the catacombs.
